body:
Epic: #278. Design deliverables: #279, #280, #281, #282, #283, #284.

This packet evaluates separate front jack/control boards, a local middle interconnect zone and removable rear OSC cards against a limited-change core-only alternative. Independent circuit, electrical and mechanical/service reviews recommend **REVISE**. It delivers a reproducible negative design checkpoint; it does not complete the blocked physical/electrical acceptance criteria or adopt either architecture.

Preserves all 33 functions, five oscillators, 438 locked centres, canonical CAD/copper, decision.json and KEEP_K1402_INCUMBENT. PR260/277 remain parked drafts. No native/numerical campaigns, merge or hardware action.

Implemented:
- Full source/package/unit/reuse ledger and 100 immutable PR261 trim-semantic joins.
- Live O1/shared-reference net/Ref-pin/package extraction, O2/O5 mapping, five raw wipers, six trims, existing rear terminals and all 11 harnesses/51 conductors/both connector faces.
- Parameterized adjacent geometry/access drawing and fail-closed electrical allocations, source hashes, deterministic generators and 43 focused tests.
- Complete same-path assembly subtotal, independent reviews/fixes, honest acceptance matrix and separately approvable next prompt.

Key blockers: final connector/returns/services/terminal conversion, package and support fit, 20 mm finger envelope at 17 mm pitch, actual dynamic/fault loads and complete path resistance, reference error/dynamic loading. Literal two-link topology increases O1 crimps from102 to204 before extra services; no cost/time saving claimed.

Start at `design/architecture-278/GATE.md`, `WORK.md`, `validation.md` and `NEXT-PROMPT.md`. Reviewed source checkpoint: `48b7847abb3d076b967132ebfb13c5dd11902aa0`; base main: `65cefd41fc39e064d38319115ad96016a1c6b71c`.

Validation:43 focused tests, four deterministic generators/protected-path guard, circuit:check before/after, pnpm check, guarded298-page build and check:site PASS. Manual inventory SCOPE remains68 lines/0 declared placements/no schematic-placement binding; pin-asset check performed. Existing site-link allowlist unchanged.

CI intentionally skipped with `[skip ci]`: inspected default workflow launches native checks/DRC not authorized here. No CI PASS claimed. Aggregate regeneration/native/physical qualification NOT RUN. Keep all unmet issues open. Owner next decision: bounded functional redesign with explicit enclosure/support/card/removal limits and budget, or prioritize core-only comparison retaining front copper.
